observations: Photo 0 shows a standing fan with a wall/ceiling-style mounting/charging-looking unit attached to the side (black circular base with a cable).
Photo 1 shows a close view of the fan head and center hub; the hub has a visible logo/label that appears to read 'Qasa'.
No clear model number, battery capacity, or charger specifications are readable in the photos.
No photo shows the fan running, battery indicator, or runtime measurement.

read_from: photo 1 fan hub label (appears to read 'Qasa')

claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a fan hub label that appears to read 'Qasa' and the setup looks like a rechargeable/charging arrangement.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low...
claims.evidence: No photo/video shows the fan running on battery with a timer or battery indicator.

risks.risk: Battery health/capacity may be weak, so runtime may be far less than claimed.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the fan running on battery from full charge with a visible timer (or battery indicator) showing at least 1–2 hours.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not meeting the claimed runtime (worst case: treat as low/unknown runtime).

risks.risk: Fan may not be truly rechargeable (could be mainly mains-powered with a non-working/weak battery).
risks.proof: Ask for a clip showing it running after unplugging from mains/charger for several minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not reliably rechargeable (worst case: assume it needs power to run).

risks.risk: Fan size/airflow performance (e.g., blade diameter) is not clearly readable; could be smaller than expected.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo with a measuring tape across the blade diameter (or a clear label/spec sheet).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic rechargeable standing fan without confirmed size.

risks.risk: Condition issues (wobble, noise, broken blades, weak oscillation) can’t be confirmed from still photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a video of the fan running at low and high speeds, including oscillation if available, showing no abnormal noise/vibration.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition (worst case: assume possible minor wear affecting performance).

proof_requests: Video: fan running on battery after unplugging, with a visible timer and battery/charge indicator (or charger unplug moment).
Video: run on low speed and high speed for a few minutes each (showing no wobble/noise).
Photo: blade diameter measurement (tape measure) or any readable spec label/model on the fan/charger.
Photo: charger/battery label showing capacity (Ah/Wh) and voltage, if present.
response.reason: The photos suggest a Qasa rechargeable standing fan, but the key pricing driver (battery runtime and whether it truly runs on recharge) is not provable from the images. Without proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be confidently selected from the comparables.
